items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the sheaf property and limit preservation of the flatness-in-dimensions function at source lines 2121-2130, label lemma-flat-dimension-n, whose proof occupies source lines 2132-2166. Neither part is a citation: for the sheaf property the proof chooses the chart of the chart lemma and identifies the value of the functor on a test scheme with the value of the chart functor on the fibre product, which converts an fpqc covering into an fpqc covering of that fibre product and lets the chart case be applied. For limit preservation it has to manufacture the right limit: it picks an affine open of the fibre product mapping surjectively onto a stage and takes inverse images to obtain a filtered limit of affine schemes over the chart, after which the identification of the two functors and limit preservation in the chart case give the conclusion. The counted statement records neither the chart reduction nor the construction of the limit.
